comments.body:
**Heads-up for maintainers**

This PR is from a fork and touches integrations whose integration tests require API keys.
Those tests are **skipped** in CI because fork PRs don't have access to repo secrets for security reasons.

Affected integrations:
- amazon_bedrock
- transformers

Please run the integration tests locally (`hatch run test:integration` inside each folder) before approving.
<!-- Sticky Pull Request Commentfork-pr-api-keys -->
## Coverage report (amazon_bedrock) _This PR does not seem to contain any modification to coverable code._
## Coverage report (transformers) _This PR does not seem to contain any modification to coverable code._

Note on CI coverage: `Test / transformers` and `Test / amazon-bedrock` ran and are green, but there is no `google_vertex` workflow in `.github/workflows/`, so that third of the PR is not covered by CI here. Verified locally instead — `pytest integrations/google_vertex/tests/test_text_embedder.py`: 10 passed, and 3 of them fail if I revert only the `to_dict` change:

```
FAILED tests/test_text_embedder.py::test_to_dict
FAILED tests/test_text_embedder.py::test_task_type_survives_a_serialization_round_trip
FAILED tests/test_text_embedder.py::test_progress_bar_and_truncate_dim_survive_a_serialization_round_trip
```

Happy to split google_vertex into its own PR if you would rather land the two CI-covered integrations first.

Ran the integration tests locally as the bot asks, with `hatch`, from inside each integration folder.

**transformers** — the two integration tests in the file this PR touches pass (real models downloaded, no key needed):

```
$ cd integrations/transformers && hatch run test:integration -q -k extractive
tests/test_extractive_reader.py::test_t5 PASSED
tests/test_extractive_reader.py::test_roberta PASSED
2 passed, 136 deselected in 93.59s
```

**amazon_bedrock** — the five `S3Downloader` integration tests need a real bucket, so they skip here, with their own reason:

```
$ cd integrations/amazon_bedrock && hatch run test:integration -q -k s3_downloader -rs
5 skipped, 415 deselected
SKIPPED [5] Export an env var called `S3_DOWNLOADER_BUCKET` containing the S3 bucket to run this test.
```

`hatch run test:unit` in that integration: 352 passed, 68 deselected.

Worth saying plainly: this PR only adds keys to `to_dict`, which no integration test exercises — they all call `run()` against a live service. The unit tests are the ones that cover it, and I verified each fails without its one-line change.

**google_vertex** — while getting local evidence for the third integration I found that it has no workflow at all in `.github/workflows/`, and its suite is already red on `main` for an unrelated reason (`haystack-ai` 3.1.0 added `async_function` to `Tool`). Filed separately as #3874 so it does not get mixed up with this PR. With those two pre-existing failures excluded, `hatch run test:unit` in `google_vertex` is 64 passed, including the three that cover this change.

@sjrl pointed out on #3874 that `google_vertex` is discontinued and archived — it is in the status table of the top-level README, which I had not checked. **I have removed that third of this PR** (`c5312c1`); a serialization fix in an archived integration is churn, not a fix.

That is the same reasoning I used to leave `NvidiaGenerator` out of this PR for being deprecated, so I should have caught it. The README table is the check I was missing, and it also retires the CI-coverage caveat I raised earlier: everything left here is covered.

**What remains, both integrations active and both green in this PR's CI:**

| Component | Dropped from `to_dict` | Already serialized by |
|---|---|---|
| `TransformersExtractiveReader` | `overlap_threshold` | — |
| `S3Downloader` | `boto3_config` | `AmazonBedrockGenerator`, `AmazonBedrockChatGenerator`, and the three Bedrock embedders |

Two one-line changes, each with a round-trip test that fails without it. Integration tests run locally and reported above: `transformers` 2 passed, `amazon_bedrock` skipped for want of a real bucket, unit suites 35 and 352 passed.

Title updated to match. Happy to split the two remaining integrations apart as well if you would rather review them separately.

Following up — this has been quiet for ~10 days. After dropping the archived `google_vertex` portion, it's a focused `to_dict` fix for two components, each an init param that is accepted, stored and used but left out of `to_dict` so it reverts to default on `from_dict`:

- `TransformersExtractiveReader` — `overlap_threshold` (changes which overlapping answers `run` deduplicates, so the answer set differs after a round trip)
- `S3Downloader` — `boto3_config` (builds the botocore `Config`: timeouts, retries, proxies)

One line per parameter in `to_dict`, no `from_dict` change needed. Regression tests per integration, verified red by reverting only the `to_dict` change. CI is green and the branch is up to date. Ready for review whenever there's capacity.
